scope: Flat numerical fixtures and command-mapper tests. Same declared initial conditions and protocols within each comparison. No WebGL, GPU/FPS, keyboard/device latency, camera feel, city collision route or Tesla calibration acceptance.

checks.name: The service-brake/load-transfer cause is isolated before adding the continuous pedal handover
Gentle inputs, opposite turns, straight full braking and split-friction limits are retained under actual wheel integration
Passing one percent brake no longer removes the lift-off force; a nondecreasing envelope stays inside 42 kN
Contact loss cannot duplicate an axle budget and low-speed brake input cannot release parking hold
Actual passive torque/work is separated after ABS and wheel stopping, without inventing battery recharge
Gamepad centre/edge/full-scale continuity and keyboard priority are exercised through the real input mapper
Blended braking snapshots replay exactly and reset clears the new brake diagnostics

pedalEnvelope.lowPedalMeaning: The first part of brake travel transfers existing lift-off deceleration to service brakes; it does not add a second brake pool.

energyLedger.scope: Mechanical work removed from wheel motion. No battery recuperation efficiency or battery recharge is implemented; nominal regenPower still bounds the existing speed-based force request, not a newly validated substep recuperator model.

replay.result: exact full snapshot after 180 continued mixed-braking steps

limits: The primary 15% braking/full mapped-steering case is a reproduced remaining nonlinear combined-demand fault; 20% steering was already stable.
Service allocation retains a fixed 60/40 axle split; it is a simplified within-axle load-aware distribution, not a calibrated OEM EBD/ESC.
Split-friction hard corner braking still produces a real slide; no yaw/velocity override or friction increase is used.
The low-speed hold remains a compliant tire/static-friction approximation with small creep, not a pose clamp.
Equivalent motor retardation removes mechanical energy; no electrical energy is returned to the battery.
The selected limits remain engineering assumptions: dry mu 1.25, 700 kW traction, 42 kN brake request and 20 kN per main nozzle.
